description:
The Interact Club students with their teacher coordinators , have agreed to conduct the ' Anti Honking' drive activity , scheduled as stated below:

Date: 7th August 2026

Day : Friday

Venue : Outside the school gate

Time : 7.15 to 8.15 am
Today's Anti Honking drive event organised by RCLK and the Interact team ( teacher coordinators and students), was a grand success. The Principal and Vice Principal were also present for a short duration adding colour to the drive. Students were posted outside and across the school gate ( 50 metres on either side of the gate) for an hours duration. The core objective was to senstise parents towards ' No Honking' and traffic discipline.
50 students in two batches were posted holding placards 🪧, all emphasing on the objectives of the drive.
